steps.en: Only IDs that did not opt out are looked up
steps.id: Hanya ID yang tidak opt-out yang dicari kontaknya
steps.why_en: In the daily run, opted-out IDs are still sent to the data source before being dropped.
steps.why_id: Di proses harian, ID yang opt-out tetap dikirim ke sumber data sebelum dibuang.

steps.en: The ID is sent to a government source for the mobile number
steps.id: ID dikirim ke sumber data pemerintah untuk meminta nomor mobile
steps.why_en: The code uses DataHive, not DOS; they cannot be confirmed as the same from the repo.
steps.why_id: Code memakai DataHive, bukan DOS; kesamaannya tidak bisa dipastikan dari repo.

steps.en: The latest mobile number is received and saved
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru diterima dan disimpan

steps.en: No usable number means no SMS; a letter is used
steps.id: Tanpa nomor yang valid, SMS tidak dikirim; pakai surat

steps.en: An SMS is sent the same day
steps.id: SMS dikirim di hari yang sama
steps.why_en: Only the morning run can send that day, and sending is switched off in the repo settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya run pagi yang terkirim hari itu, dan pengiriman nonaktif di properti repo.
